For [math](/docs/shell/commands/categories/math/).

<div class='command-title'>Returns the arcsine of the number.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> math arcsin {flags} ```

## Flags

 -  `--degrees, -d`: Return degrees instead of radians.


## Input/output types:

| input        | output      |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| number       | float       |
| list&lt;number&gt; | list&lt;float&gt; |
## Examples

Get the arcsine of 1
```nu
> 1 | math arcsin
1.5707963267948966
```

Get the arcsine of 1 in degrees
```nu
> 1 | math arcsin --degrees
90.0
```
